source.title: An illustrated description of Mah-Jong (BMJA rules)

rules.specification: Exposed and concealed chows score no points.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores no points for chows

rules.specification: An exposed pung of a minor suited tile scores 2.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a exposed minor pung as 2

rules.specification: A concealed pung of a minor suited tile scores 4.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a concealed minor pung as 4

rules.specification: An exposed pung of a terminal, wind or dragon scores 4.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a exposed major pung as 4

rules.specification: A concealed pung of a terminal, wind or dragon scores 8.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a concealed major pung as 8

rules.specification: An exposed kong of a minor suited tile scores 8.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a exposed minor kong as 8

rules.specification: A concealed kong of a minor suited tile scores 16.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a concealed minor kong as 16

rules.specification: An exposed kong of a terminal, wind or dragon scores 16.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a exposed major kong as 16

rules.specification: A concealed kong of a terminal, wind or dragon scores 32.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a concealed major kong as 32

rules.specification: A pair of any dragon scores 2.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a dragon pair as 2

rules.specification: A pair of the player's own wind scores 2.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores own and prevailing wind separately on the same pair

rules.specification: A pair of the prevailing wind scores 2; it stacks with own wind.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores own and prevailing wind separately on the same pair

rules.specification: Each flower scores 4.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores every flower and season as 4

rules.specification: Each season scores 4.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores every flower and season as 4

rules.specification: Going Mah-Jong scores 20.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores 20 for Mah-Jong and 2 for a live-wall win

rules.specification: Drawing the winning tile from the live wall scores 2.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores 20 for Mah-Jong and 2 for a live-wall win

rules.specification: Each pung or kong of dragons gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives one double for each dragon pung or kong

rules.specification: A pung or kong of own wind gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives two doubles when a wind set is both own and prevailing

rules.specification: A pung or kong of prevailing wind gives one double and stacks with own wind.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives two doubles when a wind set is both own and prevailing

rules.specification: The flower matching player wind gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives one double for an own flower or season

rules.specification: The season matching player wind gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives one double for an own flower or season

rules.specification: All four flowers give two doubles total, including own flower.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a bouquet as two doubles inclusive of the own tile

rules.specification: All four seasons give two doubles total, including own season.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: scores a season bouquet as two doubles inclusive of the own tile

rules.specification: A standard winning hand with no chows gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives winner doubles for no chows, mixed suit, all concealed, and original call

rules.specification: One suit with winds and/or dragons gives one double.
rules.test: golden-fixtures.test.ts: scores a standard mixed-one-suit winner item by item

rules.specification: A winning hand containing only terminals, winds and dragons gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives one double for a winning hand made entirely from major tiles

rules.specification: A standard winning hand whose sets and pair are concealed gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives winner doubles for no chows, mixed suit, all concealed, and original call

rules.specification: Original call gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives winner doubles for no chows, mixed suit, all concealed, and original call

rules.specification: Winning with a loose tile gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives one double for winning by loose-tile

rules.specification: Winning with the last available wall tile gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives one double for winning by last-wall-tile

rules.specification: Winning with the final discard gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives one double for winning by final-discard

rules.specification: Winning by robbing a kong gives one double.
rules.test: rules.test.ts: gives one double for winning by robbing-kong

rules.specification: Four pungs/kongs and a pair in one suit, no honours or chows; bonus tiles score separately.
rules.test: golden-fixtures.test.ts: scores Purity and bonus tiles as separate components

rules.specification: A standard score cannot exceed the configured limit, normally 1000.
rules.test: score.test.ts: caps a standard score at the table limit

rules.specification: Special-hand bonus points are calculated separately, added, then the total is capped.
rules.test: golden-fixtures.test.ts: caps a limit special hand after separately calculating bonuses

rules.specification: Seven pairs of major tiles; terminals are allowed and pairs may repeat.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects all pair honours with terminals and repeated pairs

rules.specification: Seven pairs, each made from the same number in two different suits; duplicate pairs are allowed.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects Knitting with repeated cross-suit pairs

rules.specification: Four same-number groups across all three suits, plus a same-number pair across two suits; duplicate triplets are allowed.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects Triple Knitting with duplicate triplets

rules.specification: One of each dragon, wind, suited 1 and suited 9, with any one paired.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects thirteen unique wonders from ungrouped tiles

rules.specification: Four pungs/kongs and a pair made only from Green Dragon or Bamboo 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects Imperial Jade with pungs, a kong, and a green pair

rules.specification: A concealed one-suit layout containing pungs of 1 and 9, a run from 2 to 8 and a pair among 2 to 8; final-claim provenance is not yet represented.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects the concealed Gates of Heaven layout

rules.specification: A pair of suited 1s, a suited run from 2 to 9 in the same suit, and one of each Wind.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects the Wriggling Snake layout

rules.specification: Four pungs/kongs and a pair made only from winds and dragons.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects all honours

rules.specification: Four pungs/kongs and a pair made only from suited 1s and 9s.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects all terminals

rules.specification: Four kongs and a pair.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects four kongs

rules.specification: Pungs/kongs of all three dragons, another pung/kong and any pair.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects three great scholars

rules.specification: Pungs/kongs of all four winds and any pair.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: detects four winds

rules.specification: Four concealed pungs and a pair, using one suit with optional winds/dragons; no kongs or chows.
rules.test: special-hands.test.ts: rejects kongs and mixed suits for buried treasure

rules.specification: Ordinary doubles do not apply to a special hand; eligible doubles apply only to bonus-tile points.
rules.test: golden-fixtures.test.ts: scores All pair honours plus separately doubled bonus tiles

rules.specification: For a special hand, final discard doubles bonus-tile points only.
rules.test: golden-fixtures.test.ts: applies final-discard doubling only to special-hand bonus tiles

rules.specification: A declared special fishing hand must be a non-winner that becomes the selected supported special by adding exactly one legal playing tile; a dead required tile still qualifies.
rules.test: fishing.test.ts: detects and rejects one-tile-away declarations for every supported special

rules.specification: All Pair Honours, Knitting and Triple Knitting score 200 while fishing.
rules.test: fishing.test.ts: detects a genuine one-tile-away hand and scores every fixed fishing value

rules.specification: Supported 1,000-point tile-pattern specials score 400 while fishing.
rules.test: fishing.test.ts: detects a genuine one-tile-away hand and scores every fixed fishing value

rules.value: greater of published fishing value or intrinsic value
rules.specification: Three Great Scholars, All Winds and Dragons, and Four Blessings use intrinsic playing-tile value when it exceeds 400; Purity uses its published three-doubles treatment or the greater whole-hand intrinsic treatment.
rules.test: fishing.test.ts: uses the higher intrinsic fishing value

rules.specification: Flowers and Seasons remain separate from the special fishing value; eligible own-tile and bouquet doubles apply to their subtotal unless the greater whole-hand Purity intrinsic option is used.
rules.test: golden-fixtures.test.ts: scores the published North Thirteen Unique Wonders fishing example

removed.reason: Not a BMJA special hand; it was an accidental cross-variant rule.

removed.rule: Generic pure one-suit hand including chows
removed.reason: BMJA Purity specifically requires pungs/kongs and a pair.

ambiguities.detail: The general scoring page awards the extra 2 points only for a live-wall draw, while the Purity notes say live wall or kong box. The engine retains the unambiguous loose-tile double but does not guess at the conflicting 2-point interpretation.

BMJA permits the final pung or pair to be claimed to go Mah-Jong. The current hand contract cannot identify which set contains the winning tile, so the detector conservatively requires all sets concealed.
